title: In This Valley You Fall APART If Your Family Forgets You
description:
Where I live, if your family forgets you, your body comes apart, block by block. Newlyweds click tight overnight. Grandads with big families squeak when they walk.

I've been coming loose for four years. Dad's all the family I've got, and for his sixtieth he wanted one thing: a balloon flight at dawn over a valley full of mist, just him and me.

It's made up. Built with code and Blender.
pin: Who in your family is holding you together right now?
